title: FloodGuard Flood Loss Load
content:
A flood loss load applies to the building premium of a FloodGuard Private Flood Policy at its renewal offer, read from the flood claim payments issued on the policy and counted back from the renewal offer date.

## Rule

A flood loss load raises the building premium by 15 percent when a flood claim payment was issued on the policy within the 36 months before the renewal offer date; by 5 percent when no flood claim payment was issued within those 36 months but one was issued within the 120 months before the renewal offer date; and by nothing when no flood claim payment was issued within the 120 months.

A payment is placed by the date it was issued, whatever coverage part it paid.

## Load schedule

| Flood claim payments issued on the policy | Load on the building premium |
|---|---|
| At least one within the 36 months before the renewal offer date | 15 percent |
| None within the 36 months, at least one within the 120 months | 5 percent |
| None within the 120 months | No load |

## Cases on either side of the windows (hypothetical)

| Most recent flood claim payment issued | Load |
|---|---|
| 35 months before the renewal offer date | 15 percent |
| 37 months before the renewal offer date | 5 percent |
| 119 months before the renewal offer date | 5 percent |
| 121 months before the renewal offer date, none since | No load |
| Never | No load |

## Effect in figures (hypothetical)

A building premium of 600.00 raised by 15 percent is 690.00; raised by 5 percent it is 630.00; with no load it stays 600.00. The load acts on the building premium only; the contents premium is not loaded.
